(Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removable stem component having a length that is selected based on the anatomical requirements for implantation.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removable stem component.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2, wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

20. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1, wherein said removable stem component has a length that is adapted for anchoring in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.

21. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 20, wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removable stem component.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21, wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removable stem component by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw mechanism.
